subject: Air freight quote: MUC to SGN
body:
Hi,

Could you quote an all-in price in EUR for the fastest air freight option from MUC to SGN? The shipment will be ready on 2026-11-29, and we’ll deliver it to MUC ourselves.

It’s 4 pieces of industrial adhesives, 467 kg gross and 4.38 cbm. The packing list is attached.

Thanks!

Mira Petersen
Nordlicht Audio

classification.reasoning: The customer is requesting an all-in price for a new air freight shipment.
